purpose: Coverage/reference mapping for three research deliverables; not a regenerated per-unit phase ledger or an executed result.

auction.title: Auction, profiles, footprint and reference structure

flow.title: Order flow, participation, structure and aggression memory

volatility.title: Physical volatility, implied volatility and remaining movement

options.title: Options, open interest, exposures, flow and nodes

locations.title: Location generation, conditional quality and lifecycle

research.label: Current research
research.current: Measure the definition, run the relevant statistics/timing study, and independently evaluate its Context or Location use as specified.
research.later: Full trading-policy economics and prospective deployment where relevant.

shared_support.label: Shared research support
shared_support.current: Implement or reuse only the source/data/causality/evaluation functionality required by an actual current family study; exact services use fidelity evidence.
shared_support.later: General live platform, broker/account effects and deployment certification.

research_with_later_policy.label: Research portion now; policy later
research_with_later_policy.current: Evaluate observable reach, delay, remaining movement, candidate quality or Context information.
research_with_later_policy.later: Complete sequential act/wait/entry/exit decisions under account state and executable economics.

observable_statistics.label: Observable statistics now; Response policy later
observable_statistics.current: Preserve the source mechanism and its observable prefix, descriptive/timing statistics, and relevant Context/Location use; include failure/no-event branches.
observable_statistics.later: Full Response entry/exit and management comparison on a frozen trading opportunity set.

later_trading.label: Later trading work
later_trading.current: No implementation or successful trading result is required for the three current research deliverables. Preserve existing code and evidence.
later_trading.later: Retain the original trading-policy/execution/account contract for a later trading project.
